environment.description: Spring Boot 2.7 service deployed on ECS Fargate. The ECS task role (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/userservice-task-role) has a broad DynamoDB policy: Action dynamodb:UpdateItem, dynamodb:GetItem, dynamodb:PutItem on Resource arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:111222333444:table/UserProfiles. No condition keys are applied. No API Gateway or WAF in front of the ALB. The service is exposed via an internal ALB with no request filtering.

config.network: internal ALB, no WAF, no API Gateway
